cases.name: a-scale-on-a-page-without-one
cases.covers: Page 4 gets a viewport of its own, over the visible box (its crop box), named EmbedPDF. The result names the page and carries the new layout; so does the read after it.

cases.name: a-scale-replaces-the-engines-own-viewport
cases.covers: Page 3 already has one the engine owns: that one becomes the new scale over the visible page, in its place; the foreign one stays as it is.

cases.name: null-removes-the-engines-own-viewport
cases.covers: A null measure removes every viewport the engine owns on the page and leaves the foreign one.

cases.name: null-on-a-page-with-none-of-its-own
cases.covers: Page 5 has only a geospatial viewport, which the engine does not own: removing the scale leaves it.

cases.name: a-scale-on-a-turned-page
cases.covers: Page 5 is turned a quarter. Its own viewport covers the visible page in the file, and the layout reads it back in page space, after the geospatial one.

cases.name: one-change-scales-several-pages
cases.covers: Three pages of three sizes in one op: each takes the scale on its own visible box. The result names the first page; the item names them all.

cases.name: a-page-named-twice-is-refused
cases.covers: The same page twice is refused with InvalidArg before anything is written.

cases.name: an-unknown-page-is-refused
cases.covers: An object number no page has refuses the change.

cases.name: an-undo-puts-back-each-pages-scale
cases.covers: Three pages with three different scales before (another one, none, none of its own): the undo puts each back, in steps grouped by what the page had and its box.

cases.name: an-undo-leaves-a-page-whose-scale-moved-on
cases.covers: A page given another scale after the change is not the change's to undo: the undo skips it and puts back only the other page.
